statement:
by
  classical
  let chen := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2
  let good := fun n : ℕ => ∃ p q : ℕ, chen p ∧ chen q ∧ p+q=n
  exact ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T ≤ X → (((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun t => ¬good (6*t^2+4))).card:ℝ) ≤ (X:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在稀疏目标 6t²+4 上证明双陈素数表示，仅允许对参数 t 有幂节省的例外。
plain_statement.en: Power-saving exceptions in the parameter for two Chen primes on quadratic targets 6t²+4.

brief.zh: 该序列落在原论文的局部允许类，但到高度 Y 仅约 √Y 项，原密度结论不能直接限制它。可把论文的异常集对偶和换成二次相位和，检查大弧下界能否覆盖该稀疏采样的次弧误差。
brief.en: These targets satisfy the mod-six condition but have square-root density in height. Replace the exceptional-set dual sum by a quadratic-phase sum; preserve the major-arc lower bound while controlling the sparse sampling error.
